entries.name: SUPPLIER_INVOICES_IMPORT_DIR
entries.description: Folder of supplier invoice and memo exports, with one subfolder per supplier named in lowercase, such as test_supplier. Never inside a git repo.
howToGet: Create a folder outside any git repo.
Inside it, make one folder per supplier, named in lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
Save each invoice and memo export the supplier sends, or the accounting system writes, as CSV into its folder.

entries.name: SUPPLIER_INVOICES_PROFILES
entries.description: Which columns each supplier's exports use: generic, or the path to a JSON file in the client's private instance repo mapping supplier folders to parsing profiles.
howToGet: Leave as generic when the exports have an invoice or memo number, a date, and an amount or unit price column.
Otherwise write the profiles in the client's private instance repo and put the file's path here.
